page_title: AST 4-0 EVE | Aston Villa v Everton 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' The substitution is prepared. Tyler Onyango (Everton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Abdoulaye Doucoure.
90+6' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Aston Villa.
90+3' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) takes the corner.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
89' Cameron Archer (Aston Villa) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Anthony Taylor didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
89' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
87' Nathan Patterson (Everton) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
85' Philippe Coutinho has picked up an injury and is replaced by Cameron Archer (Aston Villa).
84' Philippe Coutinho (Aston Villa) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
83' Rough tackle by James Garner (Everton). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
82' The resulting corner from Ashley Young (Everton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
82' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
81' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton).
81' Philippe Coutinho (Aston Villa) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
77' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

75' 4 - 0 Goal! The ball breaks to Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 4:0.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch so that Ollie Watkins can be given a rest.
72' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Anthony Taylor saw the whole situation.
72' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
68' Neal Maupay (Everton) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him.
68' Philippe Coutinho (Aston Villa) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
67' Great teamplay by Aston Villa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
65' Aston Villa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' Moussa Diaby comes off the pitch to be replaced by Diego Carlos (Aston Villa).
64' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Douglas Luiz and he is replaced by Philippe Coutinho (Aston Villa).
63' Substitution. Leon Bailey will be replaced by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa).
63' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
62' John McGinn (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Aston Villa.
61' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

60' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Neal Maupay (Everton) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the bottom left corner. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Emiliano Martinez makes a save in the nick of time to maintain the current score.
60' Ashley Young (Everton) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

60' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
57' What a huge chance for Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
53' James Garner (Everton) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
51' 3 - 0 Goal! Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
51' Corner kick. Aston Villa will have an opportunity.
51' Sean Dyche is forced to make a change. Alex Iwobi (Everton) is unable to continue due to injury, Neal Maupay comes on.
51' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Aston Villa will take a corner kick.
49' Alex Iwobi (Everton) picks up an injury.
47' Alex Iwobi (Everton) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
47' James Garner (Everton) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets too much on the ball and it goes well wide of the left post.
46' Sean Dyche has made a change at the break. Lewis Dobbin (Everton) has come on in place of Idrissa Gueye.
46' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+10' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+9' A yellow card for a tackle by Idrissa Gueye (Everton). Anthony Taylor doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45+8' John McGinn (Aston Villa) tries to find Moussa Diaby with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
45+6' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
45+4' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Michael Keane (Everton), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45+4' Nathan Patterson (Everton) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
45+2' Ashley Young (Everton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

45+2' Emiliano Martinez pulls off a great save to deny Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
45' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
44' The Aston Villa players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
42' The game is interrupted. Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

38' Dominic Calvert-Lewin looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Sean Dyche has decided that Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) is the man to take his place.
37' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) commits a foul after dangerous play.
36' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
35' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

34' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) unleashes a beautiful close-range volley to the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save and deflects the ball onto the post. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Anthony Taylor shows the yellow card to Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) for a heavy challenge.
31' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
30' The ball is out of play. Everton will have a throw-in.

29' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Jordan Pickford guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
27' Alex Iwobi (Everton) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
24' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Jordan Pickford no chance!
24' Today's referee Anthony Taylor rightly decides to book Jordan Pickford (Everton) for his harsh tackle.
24' Referee Anthony Taylor is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Aston Villa!
24' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Aston Villa using VAR. Let's see what happens.
24' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is going to take the penalty!
23' Jordan Pickford (Everton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Aston Villa.
22' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) plants a goal-bound header towards the middle of the target after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.
22' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa).
22' The ball is cleared after John McGinn (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Aston Villa can continue in their attacking effort.

21' James Garner (Everton) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Emiliano Martinez pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! John McGinn (Aston Villa) takes a short pass from Leon Bailey in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
16' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
14' The foul by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Anthony Taylor.
13' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
11' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
10' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
10' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
10' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
9' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
9' Emiliano Martinez displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
8' Aston Villa control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
7' An attempted cross from James Garner (Everton) is cleared.
6' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
5' It's a throw-in for Everton.
2' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
2' The resulting corner from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is cleared. Aston Villa force their opponents to concede a corner.
1' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) controls a cross inside the box and sends a low drive towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort. Aston Villa get a corner.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Aston Villa will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Anthony Taylor.
